samples.claim: DataOverlayGroup identifies fragment_id=1 and repeated overlays=2 appended in order to existing overlays, preserving concurrently committed entries rather than replacing the list. Writer leaves committed_version zero; commit stamps the actual new version and restamps on retry. Touched fields come from each overlay data_file.fields. DataOverlay.groups=1 attaches sparse cell changes without rewriting base files. Its comment points through table.proto's public import to DataOverlayFile now declared in fragment_metadata.proto (protos/table.proto:11-11; protos/fragment_metadata.proto:185-238); exact permissive conflict rules are delegated to specs/implementation rather than specified here.
